INVITATION TO BID FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF
LA CONSOLACION ELEM. SCHOOL WATER SYSTEM,
BRGY. LA CONSOLACION, MIAGAO, ILOILO
The Municipality of Miagao through the Budget for the Contract Approved by the
Sanggunian, Trust Fund - Provincial Aid, Budget Year 2018 intends to apply the sum
of P 239,406.00 being the Approved Budget for the Contract (ABC) to payments under
the contract for Supply and Delivery of Materials and Supplies for the Construction of
La Consolacion Elem. School Water System, Brgy. La Consolacion, Miagao, Iloilo. Bids
received in excess of the ABC shall be automatically rejected at bid opening.
The Municipality of Miagao now invites bids for the following:
ITEM NO. | QUANTITY | UNIT ITEM DESCRIPTION
1 62 bags | portland cement
Z 8.5 cu.m. | screened gravel
3 7 cu.m. | washed sand
4 127 pcs 12mm x 6./0 steel bars

6 24 shts__| 1/4" x 4' x 8' ordinary plywood
7 11 pcs 2" x 3" x 10' coco lumber
8 17 pcs 2" x 2" x 10' coco lumber
9 18 pcs hacksaw blade
10 5 kgs __| assorted nails (1", 3", 4" CW nails)
11 9 pcs 9mm x 6.0 steel bars
12 2 kgs | 2" common wire nails
13 420 mtrs_ | 11/4"@ HDPE pipes SDR - II
14 7 pes _| 11/4"@ PE coupling
15 55 pcs 3/4" teflon tape
